buyers.name: Star City Games
buyers.store_credit_bonus: None on bulk: help center says 'Sealed products and bulk items sold for store credit do not receive a trade-in bonus' (bonus applies only to eligible non-bulk items). Bulk credit value = cash value.
buyers.minimum: No minimum quantity stated for bulk. Check payment needs a Sell List total of at least $10. Star City account required (Sell List and Ship + Sell).
buyers.shipping: Seller pays all shipping to Roanoke VA, and return shipping on rejects (Ship + Sell declined offers: SCG pays return within continental US). Sell List requests must be postmarked within 2 business days of approval to hold prices; Ship + Sell has no ship deadline. Customs/postage due deducted from payout. Also buys in person at the Roanoke store (appointment) and at SCG CON booths.
buyers.volume_bonus: None for bulk. Ship + Sell processing fee drops from 10% to 5% on requests of $10,000 or more.
buyers.condition_rules: Bulk must be Near Mint or Played, English. Heavily Played bulk is not purchased. Bulk rates adjusted down (or refused) if guidelines not met.
buyers.sorting_rules: Unsleeved, out of binders/top-loaders, all cards facing the same direction. Bulk commons/uncommons must be a good mix of both rarities; bulk basic lands must be a mix of land types. Sell List route: bulk is added to the cart by quantity under 'Bulk'; cards in listed order (up to 5% penalty otherwise). Ship + Sell route: send unsorted, SCG sorts and grades, but deducts a 10% processing fee (5% if $10k+); any single card whose Sell List price is under $1 is paid at the bulk price.
buyers.excluded: Per help center: bulk non-English, bulk Heavily Played, bulk Time Spiral Timeshifted, bulk tokens (note: the live rates API still lists a token rate with is_buying=true), bulk with large quantities of any one card. Rates exclude Unfinity/Unstable/Unsanctioned (separate $0.001 line for non-foil R/M) and, for foil rares, Mystery Booster. FAB: non-foil common/rare/super rare/token, rainbow-foil common/rare/SR/token, gold foil, promos, marvel/fabled/legendary rainbow foil are flagged not buying. Lorcana: enchanted, foil enchanted, inkwashed, non-foil promo flagged not buying. Riftbound tokens flagged not buying.
buyers.turnaround: Approval email within 2 business days. Sell List requests processed in 5-7 business days after receipt. Ship + Sell: offer within ~5 business days for up to 1,000 cards (+1 business day per extra 1,000). PayPal paid within 1-2 business days of acceptance; check printed within 2 business days (USPS mail).
buyers.process: Create a Star City account. Either (a) Sell List: add the bulk categories (Sell List > Bulk) to the Sell Cart, choose store credit / PayPal / check, submit, wait for approval email, then ship; or (b) Ship + Sell form for unsorted collections. Do not ship before the approval email.

notes: Agent: mtg-agent, 2026-10-20. Search budget used: 24 of 25 WebSearch calls. All rates were read from the URLs recorded per buyer; nothing estimated. Technique notes for re-checks: (1) Shopify pages expose /pages/<handle>.json with updated_at (used to date pages and to catch a stale duplicate at mightymeeple.com); (2) SCG's bulk prices come from a public JSON, sellyourcards.starcitygames.com/api/settings (bulkCategories); (3) Card Throne reads a public Firestore document; (4) Geek Oasis, Bear's Den and 6AGames keep rates in form definitions (Google Forms FB_PUBLIC_LOAD_DATA_, Cognito, Globo) - Google and Globo were readable, Cognito was not. Surprises: Nutmeg Games (New Milford CT, in-person only) pays $20/1000 MTG and $30/1000 Pokemon, 2-4x the mail-in norm ($5-8/1000). Star City Games raised MTG C/U to $8/1000 on 2026-07-20 (was $6). Card Kingdom explicitly paused bulk purchasing. Highest MTG common/uncommon MAIL-IN cash rates found: CoolStuffInc $8 (credit $10), Star City Games $8, Geek Oasis $8, Card Throne $7, 6AGames $6. Rare/mythic bulk: Star City Games 8c/25c, Card Throne 5c/15c, Cape Fear 5c/15c, Geek Oasis 7c/20c, 6AGames 7c/20c. SCG basic lands $15/1000 is the best basic-land rate found. Mighty Meeple and Knight & Day Games and Nutmeg Games and Rain City Games are in-person only (mail_in=false). Black Knight Games (CA), Otakumart (NZ), Three for One Trading (AT), cardcosmos (DE), Magic Omens (HR), Vintage CCG (NL) are the non-US buyers; the EU ones pay only EUR 1/1000 and 5c rares. Riftbound has no code in the schema and is tagged game='other'. Values quoted 'per 5,000' at Kruk Cards were converted to per-1000 (price/5). Did NOT research tcgbulkkings.com, tcgbulk.com, monsterandshield.com, metatcg.com, tabletopvillage.com, collectorsemporium.com (assigned elsewhere); read tcgbulkkings.com's comparison page only to harvest other buyers' names. Mighty Meeple's sitemap index lists a file named sitemap_agentic_discovery.xml; it was not fetched or followed.
